PLAN "12-Week Moderate-Intensity General Fitness (Post-MI Safe)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve cardiovascular fitness and whole-body strength safely"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Tolerance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Cardio + Machine Strength A":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          recumbent_bike 1x10m rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest_press_machine 2x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row_machine 2x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_pallof_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          treadmill_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Cardio Intervals Easy + Strength B":
        warmup:
          upright_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          elliptical 1x10m rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat_light 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          machine_reverse_fly 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 2x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise_machine 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching_gentle 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Cardio Steady + Core/Balance":
        warmup:
          recumbent_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          treadmill_walk 1x12m rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl_machine 2x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
